subject: Access lineage & SCIM delta for SOC 2: evidence handoff
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@auditorworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Access lineage & SCIM delta for SOC 2: evidence handoff

Laura —

Thanks for the checklist. Per the SOC 2 fieldwork window next week, attaching the initial artifacts you requested so your team can start validation: a small SCIM delta export covering Nov–Dec 2026, a role snapshot (RBAC) as of 2026-12-31, and a service-account inventory. These are representative extracts; we can provide larger time ranges on request.

High-level notes:
- SSO / SAML: assertion logs are held in our identity provider (Okta). We can export assertion samples for specified time windows.
- SCIM: our provisioning system produces deltas in CSV (sample attached). Full deltas (JSON) are available via a secure Drive link.
- RBAC: role definitions are stored in our internal catalog; we exported current mappings and attached a role snapshot.
- Least privilege: we completed a role pruning run in Dec 2026. The remediation plan and the ticket backlog are linked (Drive).

Action items from our side:
1) Confirm the exact time window you want for SAML assertions and SCIM deltas.
2) If you need test principals or a read-only service account to query logs, let us know and we will create one.
3) We can provide an auditor-friendly runbook (who to contact, API endpoints, data retention notes) — Marissa will lead that.

I attached the small extracts for your initial review. If you'd prefer a structured handoff (SFTP or ephemeral link), we can schedule that.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: scim-delta-sample.csv (CSV, 42KB); rbac-role-snapshot-20261231.json (JSON, 120KB); service-account-inventory.xlsx (XLSX, 85KB)

From: Laura Chen <laura@auditorworks.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access lineage & SCIM delta for SOC 2: evidence handoff

Diego —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the sample artifacts, they look helpful. A few clarifying questions before we request the full exports: 

1) Time window: please provide SCIM delta and SAML assertion samples for 2026-10-01 through 2026-12-31. We need the quarter-end snapshot plus preceding 3 months to validate provision/deprovision activity.
2) SAML assertions: we will need one example assertion per application (web and API) and metadata showing the AssertionConsumerService URL and NameID format.
3) RBAC: the snapshot is great — can you also include the mapping from role -> permission IDs (a short CSV) and a brief note on role ownership (who approves role changes)?
4) Evidence delivery: preferred method is an ephemeral Drive link per file with access granted to compliance@auditorworks.com.

Also: please create a read-only auditing service account for AuditorWorks with scoped access to the SCIM export API and SAML assertion export; a 7-day token is sufficient. We will coordinate validation activities Jan 11–13.

Cc'ing your Marissa for the runbook and Priyom for the service-account provisioning.

Best,
Laura Chen
Senior Auditor, AuditorWorks LLC
laura@auditorworks.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@auditorworks.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 07:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access lineage & SCIM delta for SOC 2: evidence handoff

Hi Laura —

Per Diego's note, I've staged the requested exports and added a short runbook in Drive. Items placed in the shared reviewer folder: 
- SCIM_delta_20261001_20261231.json (full delta export, 12MB)
- SAML_assertion_samples.zip (sample assertions for web/api apps, 300KB)
- role_to_permission_map.csv (CSV, 18KB)
- runbook_access_and_endpoints.md (runbook, includes API endpoints and sample curl commands)

Drive link (ephemeral, expires 2027-01-14): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExampleLink

Priyom — can you spin up the read-only auditor service account and post the credential blob in the same folder (rotate token after 7 days)?

Laura — once you've confirmed access works, we can schedule a short walkthrough (15–20m) on Jan 11 to show how to pull additional deltas if needed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: runbook_access_and_endpoints.md (text), role_to_permission_map.csv (CSV)

From: Laura Chen <laura@auditorworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access lineage & SCIM delta for SOC 2: evidence handoff

Marissa / Diego —

I can confirm the Drive link and sample files are accessible and the runbook is clear. The read-only service account credentials worked for a test export.

Next steps:
- I'll validate the SCIM deltas against our provisioning test plan and report any anomalies by EOD Jan 12.
- Please leave the Drive link live until Jan 14.
- If we need longer access, I'll open a request via compliance@auditorworks.com.

Appreciate the quick support — looking forward to the short walkthrough on Jan 11.

Best,
Laura
